SELECT id,
    vertical_id,
    vendor_profile_id,
    name,
    market_type,
    address,
    city,
    state,
    zip,
    day_of_week,
    start_time,
    end_time,
    status,
    created_at,
    updated_at,
    active,
    contact_email,
    submitted_by,
    submitted_at,
    reviewed_by,
    reviewed_at,
    rejection_reason,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    geocoding_failed,
    contact_phone,
    timezone,
    cutoff_hours,
    season_start,
    season_end,
    approval_status,
    submitted_by_vendor_id,
    description,
    website,
    vendor_sells_at_market,
    expires_at
   FROM markets
  WHERE ((status = 'active'::text) AND ((expires_at IS NULL) OR (expires_at > now())));

SELECT lm.market_id,
    count(DISTINCT l.vendor_profile_id) AS vendor_count
   FROM (listing_markets lm
     JOIN listings l ON ((l.id = lm.listing_id)))
  WHERE ((l.status = 'published'::listing_status) AND (l.deleted_at IS NULL))
  GROUP BY lm.market_id;

SELECT error_code,
    count(*) AS report_count,
    count(DISTINCT vertical_id) AS affected_verticals,
    max(created_at) AS last_reported,
    min(created_at) AS first_reported,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'resolved'::text)) AS resolved_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'acknowledged'::text, 'escalated'::text, 'in_progress'::text]))) AS open_count
   FROM error_reports
  WHERE (error_code IS NOT NULL)
  GROUP BY error_code
  ORDER BY (count(*)) DESC;

SELECT error_code,
    attempted_fix,
    migration_file,
    failure_reason,
    created_at
   FROM error_resolutions
  WHERE (status = 'failed'::text)
  ORDER BY error_code, created_at DESC;

SELECT er.id,
    er.error_code,
    er.trace_id,
    er.vertical_id,
    er.page_url,
    er.user_agent,
    er.reported_by_user_id,
    er.reporter_email,
    er.user_description,
    er.status,
    er.escalation_level,
    er.assigned_to_user_id,
    er.resolution_id,
    er.resolution_notes,
    er.vertical_admin_notes,
    er.escalated_at,
    er.escalated_by_user_id,
    er.platform_admin_notes,
    er.resolved_at,
    er.resolved_by_user_id,
    er.created_at,
    er.updated_at,
    v.name_public AS vertical_name,
    v.vertical_id AS vertical_slug,
    el.message AS error_message,
    el.context AS error_context,
    el.breadcrumbs AS error_breadcrumbs,
    res.status AS resolution_status,
    res.attempted_fix AS resolution_fix
   FROM (((error_reports er
     LEFT JOIN verticals v ON ((v.vertical_id = er.vertical_id)))
     LEFT JOIN error_logs el ON ((el.trace_id = er.trace_id)))
     LEFT JOIN error_resolutions res ON ((res.id = er.resolution_id)))
  WHERE ((er.escalation_level = 'platform_admin'::text) AND (er.status <> ALL (ARRAY['resolved'::text, 'duplicate'::text, 'cannot_reproduce'::text])))
  ORDER BY er.created_at DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (error_code) error_code,
    attempted_fix,
    migration_file,
    verification_method,
    verified_at,
    verified_by
   FROM error_resolutions
  WHERE (status = 'verified'::text)
  ORDER BY error_code, verified_at DESC;

SELECT er.id,
    er.error_code,
    er.trace_id,
    er.vertical_id,
    er.page_url,
    er.user_agent,
    er.reported_by_user_id,
    er.reporter_email,
    er.user_description,
    er.status,
    er.escalation_level,
    er.assigned_to_user_id,
    er.resolution_id,
    er.resolution_notes,
    er.vertical_admin_notes,
    er.escalated_at,
    er.escalated_by_user_id,
    er.platform_admin_notes,
    er.resolved_at,
    er.resolved_by_user_id,
    er.created_at,
    er.updated_at,
    v.name_public AS vertical_name,
    v.vertical_id AS vertical_slug,
    el.message AS error_message,
    el.context AS error_context,
    el.breadcrumbs AS error_breadcrumbs
   FROM ((error_reports er
     LEFT JOIN verticals v ON ((v.vertical_id = er.vertical_id)))
     LEFT JOIN error_logs el ON ((el.trace_id = er.trace_id)))
  WHERE ((er.status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'acknowledged'::text])) AND (er.escalation_level = 'vertical_admin'::text))
  ORDER BY er.created_at DESC;

SELECT id AS vendor_id,
    referral_code,
    referred_by_vendor_id,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM vendor_referral_credits
          WHERE ((vendor_referral_credits.referrer_vendor_id = vp.id) AND (vendor_referral_credits.status = 'pending'::text))) AS pending_count,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM vendor_referral_credits
          WHERE ((vendor_referral_credits.referrer_vendor_id = vp.id) AND (vendor_referral_credits.status = 'earned'::text))) AS earned_count,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM vendor_referral_credits
          WHERE ((vendor_referral_credits.referrer_vendor_id = vp.id) AND (vendor_referral_credits.status = 'applied'::text))) AS applied_count,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(vendor_referral_credits.credit_amount_cents), (0)::bigint) AS "coalesce"
           FROM vendor_referral_credits
          WHERE ((vendor_referral_credits.referrer_vendor_id = vp.id) AND (vendor_referral_credits.status = 'earned'::text))) AS available_credits_cents,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(vendor_referral_credits.credit_amount_cents), (0)::bigint) AS "coalesce"
           FROM vendor_referral_credits
          WHERE ((vendor_referral_credits.referrer_vendor_id = vp.id) AND (vendor_referral_credits.status = ANY (ARRAY['earned'::text, 'applied'::text])) AND (vendor_referral_credits.earned_at >= date_trunc('year'::text, now())))) AS year_earned_cents,
    10000 AS annual_cap_cents,
    (10000 - ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(vendor_referral_credits.credit_amount_cents), (0)::bigint) AS "coalesce"
           FROM vendor_referral_credits
          WHERE ((vendor_referral_credits.referrer_vendor_id = vp.id) AND (vendor_referral_credits.status = ANY (ARRAY['earned'::text, 'applied'::text])) AND (vendor_referral_credits.earned_at >= date_trunc('year'::text, now()))))) AS remaining_cap_cents
   FROM vendor_profiles vp;
